review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend-only support for skill file upload, including the SkillFileUpload type, module, and component, along with client-side file count and size limit checks and related tests.
review.reason: This chunk adds the frontend implementation of skill file upload, including the SkillFileUpload type and component, along with client-side file count and size limit checks and related tests. It does not include backend implementation, so tier 3 cannot be assigned. No tier 2 or tier 3 score is assigned.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the backend implementation of the file count and size limits, nor the backend skill serializer, so tier 3 cannot be assigned. No tier 2 or tier 3 score is assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new file upload and drag-and-drop handlers, nor the SkillFileUpload type and the skillFileUpload module, nor the backend or API changes.
